versions.content: In case of an external SPI EEPROM device, the following parameters shall be published additionally in the module’s description file (see EEP038):  All SPI channels that are required for EEPROM access (read, write, erase)  Those channels shall be linked to construct SPI jobs that are linked with chip selected handling. This depends on the specific EEPROM device.  Those jobs shall be assigned to SPI sequences to be scheduled for SPI transfer A complete list of required parameters is specified in the SPI Handler/Driver Software Specification.
